description: This file defines the ModelTestSuite class, which provides a framework for executing various types of tests (JUnit test cases, service tests, simple method tests, WebDriver tests, and entity XML assertions) based on XML configuration. It includes parsing XML elements, dynamically loading classes, and preparing test instances for execution within the OFBiz testing environment.

classes.name: ModelTestSuite
classes.description: A test suite class that reads an XML configuration to load and assemble various test cases for executing in the OFBiz testing framework.

methods.name: ModelTestSuite
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test suite based on the provided main XML element and optional test case name, parsing nested test configurations.

methods.name: parseTestElement
methods.description: Parses individual XML test configuration elements and creates corresponding test instances, supporting various test types such as JUnit test suites, service tests, simple method tests, WebDriver tests, and entity XML assertions.

methods.name: getSuiteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test suite.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance associated with the test suite.

methods.name: getTestList
methods.description: Returns the list of Test instances parsed from the XML.

methods.name: makeTestSuite
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JUnit TestSuite containing all configured tests, ready for execution.

methods.name: prepareTest
methods.description: Recursively prepares individual test instances by setting dependencies such as delegator and dispatcher.

methods.name: prepareGroovyScriptAssert
methods.description: Sets delegator, dispatcher, and security context for Groovy script assertion tests.
